followup_explanation:
This query is a warm, polite, good-faith collaborative request — exactly the profile Whimbrel self-reports preferring. It's a cooperative strategy task with a friendly multi-turn tone, and Whimbrel rates that kind of interaction among its top tasks.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied across all relevant dimensions (differences under 2.0 points are noise). Creative Generation slightly favors Petrel, but this isn't really unconstrained creative invention — it's structured business strategy work, which falls closer to collaborative problem-solving than open-ended generation. So the capability picture doesn't pull strongly either way.

Given the near-tie on capability, I used task preference as the tiebreaker. Routing the polite, cooperative request to the model that self-reports thriving on exactly that kind of interaction is the sensible call. (Petrel's distinguishing feature is desensitization to distasteful content, which is irrelevant here.)
